The 2014-2015 audit issued verified links KVL-P-001543 through KVL-P-001567 and keeps four 2014 U18 candidates unresolved. The 2012-2013 audit issued KVL-P-001568 through KVL-P-001577; the reconstructed 2012 U20 roster has 10 of 12 linked while five period candidates remain unresolved across U18/U20/U19. The 2010-2011 audit issued KVL-P-001578 through KVL-P-001593. The 2008-2009 audit issued KVL-P-001594 through KVL-P-001605 and the actual 2008 U20 tournament roster is 12 of 12 linked, with the pre-tournament Seo Jaedeok to tournament Kim Bogyun registration change preserved separately. The 2006-2007 audit issued KVL-P-001606 through KVL-P-001616; reconstructed 2006 U20 and the KVA-announced 2007 U18 final 12 are both 9 of 12 linked. The 2004-2005 audit issued KVL-P-001617 through KVL-P-001630; 2004 U20 and 2005 U21 are 10 of 12 linked, while 2005 U18 and U19 are 7 of 12 linked. Seven 2004-2005 candidates remain unresolved. The 2002-2003 audit reconstructed the 2003 U21 final 12, reused KVL-P-001617 and KVL-P-001623, issued KVL-P-001631 through KVL-P-001637, and now has 9 of 12 linked. Kim Eunho, Lee Cheolgyu and Lee Dueon remain unresolved; Choi Seongbeom and Jin Hyeonu were resolved from KOVO 2006-2007 official media-guide profiles. No speculative IDs were assigned.
